scope: Existing predictions and per-position score sums only; no model forward or fitting
comparison: MIXED_REFIT minus ORIGINAL, independently within each checkpoint and storage
interaction: (UNIFORM_8 MIXED-ORIGINAL) - (NATIVE_FP32 MIXED-ORIGINAL), paired on the same base sequence

posthoc_interaction_interval.sampling_unit: base sequence, jointly across both storage and both readout conditions
posthoc_interaction_interval.multiplicity: descriptive pointwise interval; no new confirmatory family; distinct from original primary 98.333333% intervals

primary_interval: Recompute original protocol 5000 paired base-sequence resamples; seed63001+checkpoint_seed; confidence1-0.05/3; linear quantiles; unchanged
rmst0: mean(min(tau-1,Tmax)); no error contributes Tmax; INVALID counts as wrong
first_error_counts: Counts of first errors within a band / all 1024 input sequences, not a conditional hazard
conditional_margin: Only if saved per-item/per-position logits or margin exist; otherwise unavailable. Per-position sums cannot recover a selected-item conditional mean.
control: Audit frozen implementation and same item/position denominator. Overall chance-like accuracy does not imply each position is at chance.
solver: Inspect all18 candidate traces and selected6 metadata; no refitting, no new gradients, no extrapolating missing parameter deltas. FP32 equality from preserved diagnostics and patch hashes.
